mornings.message:
Flood risk for your area. Move to a safe place away from rivers and away from hill slopes. Never cross flowing water. Call 112 / 1077.

Not an official warning service; follow IMD. We never ask for money or OTP. Was this useful? 1 Yes / 2 No
mornings.draft: Store important documents (Aadhaar, ration card, land papers) and money in a plastic bag. Consider keeping them in a safe, high place. If possible, store your grain and seeds above flood level. Think about relocating your cattle to higher, safer ground, away from hill slopes. Charge your phones and keep a torch handy. Identify a shelter for flooding emergencies; use find_shelters with the hazard "flood" for options. Plan how to assist elderly, children, and those who are ill. Remember: stay away from rivers and never cross flowing water. Reach out to 1077 or 112 if water levels start to rise.
